prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your type of healthcare organization, goals, budget, timeline and required services. I can, however, help you find the best fit by giving criteria to evaluate agencies, the right questions to ask, and next steps. If you want, I can also produce a tailored shortlist of local agencies and compare them.

What to look for
- Healthcare experience: proven work with hospitals, clinics, medical device companies, pharmacies or other healthcare clients. Look for case studies and outcomes (not just creative awards).
- Regulatory/compliance knowledge: HIPAA, FDA (if applicable), state advertising rules and patient privacy best practices.
- Services you need: digital advertising (PPC, social), SEO, content/education, physician recruitment marketing, PR, branding, marketing automation, patient journey mapping, analytics.
- Measurable results: conversions, new patient acquisition cost, appointment volume, lead quality, revenue impact—not just vanity metrics.
- Data & analytics capability: ability to track cross-channel performance and attribute conversions correctly (call tracking, form tracking, EMR integration if needed).
- Size & culture fit: a boutique shop may give more hands-on work; an agency with a healthcare practice/department may provide deeper regulatory expertise.
- References & case studies: ask to speak with current/past healthcare clients similar to you.
- Technology stack & integrations: experience with your CRM/EMR, marketing automation (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce), telehealth platforms, etc.
- Pricing & contracts: retainer vs project vs performance, deliverables, termination clauses.

Questions to ask an agency
- Have you worked with organizations like ours (size, specialty, inpatient/outpatient, medical device, biotech, etc.)?
- Can you show measurable case studies (KPIs, baseline vs results)?
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient data?
- Who will be on the team and what are their backgrounds? Will we have a dedicated account manager?
- What’s your process for strategy, creative, deployment and optimization?
- How do you track and attribute leads to campaigns?
- What reporting cadence and dashboards do you provide?
- Typical timeline to see results for SEO/PPC/content?
- How do you price services and what’s included/excluded?

Red flags
- No healthcare references or case studies.
- Vague answers about HIPAA or data handling.
- Focus only on impressions/likes without conversion metrics.
- No clarity on team members or who will do the work.
- Long lock-in contracts with little performance accountability.

How I can help now
- If you tell me: your organization type (hospital system, specialty clinic, medical device, urgent care, private practice), key marketing goals, annual budget, and services needed, I’ll:
  - shortlist 4–6 St. Louis agencies with relevant healthcare experience,
  - summarize each agency’s strengths, typical clients, likely fit for you,
  - suggest questions to ask them and a simple RFP template.
- Or I can search current directories/reviews (Clutch, UpCity, Google) and present top-rated local options with links and summaries.

Which would you prefer? If you want the shortlist, please share: organization type, primary goals, budget range, and top 2 services you need.
